_note: Protocol walkthroughs (FR-HELP-3), content of docs/07_CLINICAL_RULES.md §5. Exactly the five ProtocolIds of doc 06 §1a, in table order. Step wording = the key steps of the table turned into short imperative sentences, nothing added; `tableText` is the table fragment each step renders. tag 'source' + sourceIds only where the source's `says` covers what the step acts on; every other step is 'demo wording' with no source. `timerSec` only where the table states a time. The last step of every protocol is the generic end step (kind 'send-to-surgeon'); where the table's own last step is 'notify surgeon' that step is the end step (its tableText says so). triggerRule schema: a node is a group { all: [node…] } or { any: [node…] }, or a condition — { signal, layer?, atLeast } (that signal's verdict is at least WATCH/ACT/EXPECTED by severity; layer personal|space|earth, omitted = combined verdict), { symptom } (key of the doc 07 §4.17 checklist ticked today), { cabin: 'co2Avg7dMmHg', atLeast } (number, mmHg), { spaceWeather: 'sScale', atLeast } (NOAA S level 0–5) or { spaceWeather: 's100Alert' } (≥100 MeV alert on). 'fever' has no checklist item (doc 07 §4.17 lists none), so the infection trigger uses the rash symptom; a raised temperature enters through the body_temp condition.

protocols.title: Suspected infection
protocols.summary: Steps when your resting heart rate is above your usual and your temperature is up, or a rash is ticked.
protocols.trigger: HR personal ≥ WATCH + temp WATCH, or rash/fever symptom
protocols.triggerPlain: Your resting heart rate is at Watch or higher on your personal baseline and your body temperature is at Watch or higher, or rash is ticked in the symptom checklist.

steps.text: Re-measure heart rate and temperature in 2 hours.
Send a report to the flight surgeon.

protocols.title: SPE shelter
protocols.summary: Steps when a solar particle event (SPE) raises the radiation level: shelter, dosimeter, less EVA.
protocols.triggerPlain: The NOAA solar radiation storm level is S2 or higher, or the ≥100 MeV proton alert is on [SRC_NOAA_SWPC_PROTONS]. When to shelter is a demo policy [SRC_DEMO_RADIATION_MODEL].

steps.text: Follow the Earth radiation team's instructions.
steps.tableText: follow Earth radiation team instructions [SRC_STD3001_RAD ALARA]

steps.text: Send a report to the flight surgeon.

protocols.title: CO₂ headache
protocols.summary: Steps when headache is ticked and the cabin CO₂ 7-day average is high.
protocols.triggerPlain: Headache is ticked in the symptom checklist and the cabin CO₂ 7-day average is 2.5 mmHg or more [SRC_NASA_CO2_PAGE].

steps.text: Ventilate the sleep station or improve airflow.
Send a report to the flight surgeon.

protocols.title: Vision change
protocols.summary: Steps when the Amsler grid shows new marked cells or near acuity is at Watch.
protocols.triggerPlain: The Amsler grid shows new marked cells compared with your previous map, or your near acuity is at Watch or higher.

steps.text: Repeat the test with each eye.
Use your anticipation glasses if they were issued.
Send a report to the flight surgeon.

protocols.title: Sleep debt
protocols.summary: Steps when short sleep and a slower Reaction Self-Test show up together.
protocols.triggerPlain: Sleep duration is at Watch or higher and the Reaction Self-Test is at Watch or higher.

steps.text: Avoid critical tasks if your lapses are high.
steps.tableText: avoid critical tasks if lapses high

steps.text: Send a report to the flight surgeon.
